tasks.label: prepare desktop icon (8-bit RGBA)
tasks.command: fmt=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/magick identify -format '%[type]-%z' desktop/icons/icon.png); if [ "$fmt" != "TrueColorAlpha-8" ]; then /opt/homebrew/bin/magick desktop/icons/icon.png -depth 8 -type TrueColorAlpha desktop/icons/icon.png && touch desktop/src/lib.rs && echo 'icon was not 8-bit RGBA -> normalized + forcing recompile'; else echo 'icon already 8-bit RGBA -> nothing to do'; fi

tasks.label: build desktop (.app ready)
tasks.command: fmt=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/magick identify -format '%[type]-%z' desktop/icons/icon.png); if [ "$fmt" != "TrueColorAlpha-8" ]; then /opt/homebrew/bin/magick desktop/icons/icon.png -depth 8 -type TrueColorAlpha desktop/icons/icon.png && touch desktop/src/lib.rs && echo 'icon normalized to 8-bit RGBA'; fi; cargo build --bin=patternstudio-desktop --manifest-path=desktop/Cargo.toml --features tauri/custom-protocol && bash desktop/refresh_app.sh
